connectionHost.title: Connection Host
connectionHost.description: The hostname(s) for the Cassandra server(s). Use a comma to separate multiple hostnames.

connectionPort.title: Connection Port
connectionPort.description: The port number(s) of the cassandra server(s). Use a comma to separate multiple port numbers.

username.title: Username
username.description: The username for accessing a secured Cassandra cluster.

password.title: Password
password.description: The password for accessing a secured Cassandra cluster.

resultStrategy.title: Result Strategy
resultStrategy.description: The strategy to convert the result set of the query.

query.title: Query
query.description: The query to execute against the Cassandra cluster table.

extraTypeCodecs.title: Extra Type Codecs
extraTypeCodecs.description: To use a specific comma separated list of Extra Type codecs.
